title: Wopuld Not Fit Fiberglass Enclosure
text: Wopuld Not Fit Fiberglass Enclosure. The corners in the one bath we have that has fiberglass enclosure would not let the product mount correctly.  You will need a true 90° corner for this to work

product_metadata.title: SMARTAKE 2-Pack Corner Shower Caddy, Adhesive Bath Shelf with Hooks, SUS304 Stainless Steel Storage Organizer for Bathroom, Toilet, Kitchen and Dorm, Only for 90 Degrees Right Angle, Black
features: ORGANIZE LIMITED SPACE - [This shower caddy only fits 90° right angle corner, NOT suitable for round corners]. Keep your bathroom and toilet neat and clean from all those soap, shampoos and toiletries jam-packing your way in. 2 hooks can hold the razor, towel, sponge, brush, and more.

2 DIFFERENT SIZES - There are 2 different sizes corner shower caddies (XL: 9 × 9 × 2.75 inches, L: 8.25 × 8.25 × 2.75 inches) and 8 ADHESIVES (not suckers) in one package. The stickiness of adhesive is strong, you don’t need to worry about the bath basket moving easily. No drilling required, easy installation.

DRAIN FAST - The corner shower caddy comes in an open-grid design for maximum air ventilation and water dripping away. Keep your bath products clean. The grid can prevent some small objects from falling. Our bathroom shelf can bear up to 30 lbs, DO NOT press the shampoo hard when you place it on the shower caddy. It might cause exceeding the load-bearing limit.

RUST RESISTANT - Made by rustproof SUS304 stainless steel, which can make sure the bathroom rack not easy to rust. SUS304 stainless steel has advantages such as durable and sturdy, high quality, and long lifetime. If it is rust during use, please feel free to contact us.

EASY TO INSTALL AND REMOVE - [You can refer to the video we provide to learn the installation]. INSTALL GUIDE: It is recommended to install the large layer first and put the objects you want to place on it first, and then install the small layer, to avoid the objects you want to put in after the installation is higher than the distance between the two layers. REMOVE GUIDE: Use a hairdryer to heat the sticker for 5 minutes, then tear it off.
